name: Japan New Companies
author: jpregistrydata

sections.description:
Adds the [jp_new_companies] shortcode. It lists companies newly registered in Japan (name, entity type in English, address, date), from the official corporate number registry.

Examples:

  • [jp_new_companies] — latest 20 companies
  • [jp_new_companies prefecture="13" limit="50"] — Tokyo, up to 50 (JIS prefecture code)

Requires an external service

This plugin sends requests to the Apify API (https://api.apify.com) to run the “Japan New Company Monitor” Actor (https://apify.com/jp_registry_data/japan-new-company-monitor). You need your own Apify account and API token. The Actor is billed per result by Apify (see the Actor page); the plugin caches results for 24 hours and limits each list to 100 rows.

Data sent to Apify: your API token and the shortcode filters (prefecture, limit). No visitor data is sent.
Apify terms: https://docs.apify.com/legal/general-terms-and-conditions — Privacy policy: https://docs.apify.com/legal/privacy-policy

Data source

出典：国税庁法人番号公表サイト（加工して作成）
National Tax Agency Corporate Number Publication Site, https://www.houjin-bangou.nta.go.jp/ . Processed data; not guaranteed by the National Tax Agency. The attribution line is printed under every list.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin and activate it.
  2. Open Settings > Japan New Companies and enter your Apify API token.
  3. Add the shortcode to a post or page.
sections.faq:
Do I need to pay?

The plugin is free. Apify charges for Actor results; new accounts get free monthly credit.

What happens when I delete the plugin?

The saved API token and the cached results are removed from your database.
sections.changelog:
0.1.0

  • Shortcode, settings page (API token), 24-hour cache, translation loading, clean uninstall.
